content.text:
The "Choose Pro" button on the highlighted plan is now green. It uses `var(--color-success)` (`#1a7f37`), the same green as the success messages, and keeps its white text. I didn't check it in a browser, but the 16 functional tests pass.

I added a `.plan-featured .btn-primary` rule in `site/css/pages.css`, so only that button changes. Primary buttons on other pages keep the teal brand color.

There was no darker green for hover, so I made one by mixing the success green with 15% black. If you'd rather have a dedicated hover token in `tokens.css`, that's an easy change.

STATUS: DONE
